Complete [[A Time for Heroes]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Defeat [[the Great Destroyer]].
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* 2,500 [[Dwarf reputation point]]s
* Complete the Base Objective for 40 [[Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coin]]s.
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
As per [[A Time for Heroes#Walkthrough|A Time for Heroes]] quest.
